main.description: Get the current commit for an account's permissioned repo within a space. Served by a repo host. When called with a space credential, the caller must request a MAC with an Accept-Signature header (tag atproto-space-commit), and the response carries it in Signature-Input and Signature headers covering an Atproto-Space-Commit header. Throws RepoNotFound when the account holds no repo in the space, including the case of a member that has never written to it. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services).

repo.description: The DID of the account whose latest commit to retrieve.

errors.name: InvalidSpaceMac
errors.description: The MAC requested in the Accept-Signature header is missing or invalid.
